name: Serialize snapshot refreshes with a trailing invalidation pass
description: When a stream event invalidates data while its unary snapshot read is already in flight, sharing only the current promise can publish a pre-event snapshot and lose the invalidation. Record a pending bit/key set, let the active read settle, then immediately run one coalesced trailing read. Fence timer, flush, response, and trailing work by lifecycle/key generation; authoritative replacement or key change cancels the pending pass.
example: useCoalescedSessionRefreshes serializes callback passes and useCharacterData loops once more when refetch marks its active read invalidated.
anti_pattern: Returning the current in-flight promise without recording that a newer event arrived, or launching an overlapping refresh that permits reversed responses.
